errors.text: The proposed LPBF and rolling/aging route does not reconstruct the hydride-containing ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, vacuum sintering, and quenching strategy.
The composition shifts from the Group IV–V HfNbTaTiZr target to WTaMoNbV, introducing Group VI elements W and Mo and omitting Hf, Ti, and Zr.
The claimed δ-lamellae and γ″ coherent precipitates are transferred from evidence on a chemically distinct W-Ni-Fe-Ta alloy and are not demonstrated or thermodynamically justified for WTaMoNbV.
The hypothesis misses the target mechanism of sequential hydride decomposition, in-situ alloying, controlled oxygen strengthening, and quench retention of metastable beta-BCC.
The falsification experiment specifies mixed elemental powder even though the proposed intervention requires pre-alloyed powder, so it does not directly test the stated processing hypothesis.
